headline:
Florida's mood just fell
for the sixth month straight.
[[Broward's sales didn't.]]
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
takeaway: Feelings and closings don't move on the same schedule.
sources: Sources: Florida Realtors / UF BEBR, MIAMI REALTORS + RWorld

stats.label: Florida's consumer confidence index just posted its sixth straight monthly decline.
Broward's single family home sales rose year over year for a fifth straight month in July.
Broward's $1 million and up sales climbed year over year, the strongest tier in the county.
